content: Pool Ɗel Nɗǝǝn Tii Mbǝ Dǝm nRom

Kaaɗe mo ɓeet nǝ, mun nɗel ntii kǝn mmo dǝm ɗi nyil Itali, ɓǝ mo le Pool kǝ pak nen ɗe mo a ɓuɓwoot, nsar mǝ mee ngwe ɗeɗes nkaa shiitoon mo, ɗe moo pet sǝm wur a Juliyus, ɗe nǝ a soon mǝ nentap mǝ mishkoom Agustus.

Mu ɗel nɗǝǝn mee tii ɗe nǝ tong a nyil Adramitiyum jì, ɗang nǝn mbǝ yool mbǝ dǝm ngaar yil ɗe mo nkoop yil Eshiya mo. Yaksǝ mu yool mwaan nǝ nɗǝǝn tii nǝ. Aristakus mee ngu Masidoniya mǝ yil nTasoloni, wur ɗi ashak kǝ mun zak.
Daar nǝ, ɓǝ mǝ wul nSidon. Juliyus cìn ɗeret mPool, wur shínpee mPool kǝ nwur dǝm pǝ shaar fin mo, mbǝkǝ mmo ɓam wur ɗi.
Kaaɗe mǝ yool mpeemǝnǝ, ɓǝ mu dǝm shigǝng mǝ yil nSaiprus nǝ, mbǝɗe kut nǝ daampee mmun zam.
Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓǝ mu dǝm mu wul nkor kuur ɗe nǝn ngaar Silisiya kǝ Pamfiliya. Yaksǝ mu dǝm mu wul mMira ɗe nǝn nyil nLisiya.
A mMira nǝ, ɓǝ ngwe ɗeɗes nkaa shiitoon mo, kat mee tii ɗe nǝ tong Alekzandriya jì, ɗe nǝn mbǝ dǝm Itali, ɓǝ wur le mun nɗǝǝn nǝ.

Mu cìn teer mo ɗes-ɗes mun mmwaan lee-lee, nkaa am kuur nǝ, a purut-purut ɗang mǝ jì mǝ wul kus kǝ Nidus. Kaaɗe baa kut nǝ yit mmun dǝm ɗe a kyeen kas, ɓǝ mǝ waa mǝ yaa ar nǝ shigǝng mǝ yil nKrit, kus kǝ Salmone.
A purut-purut ɗang mu jì mu wul ɗi a pǝkom ɗǝǝr nǝ, ɓǝ mu jì mǝ wul mmee mpee ɗe mo kǝ pet a peekaat ɗeret, ɗe nǝ kus kǝ pee nkaam nLasiya.

Mbǝɗǝ mun mbǝ yém ɗi mpeemǝnǝ mbǝ teer mo ɗes, ɓǝ kaaɗe mǝ yaa mwaan, ɓǝ nǝ jì kǝ jeel ɗes, mbǝɗe tar mwaan nkaa am nǝ kǝ ten ɗel, ɗang nǝ aɓwoon tartong kǝ neen, ɓǝ Pool leshap nnen ɗe mo nɗǝǝn tii nǝ.
Wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Daa mo, wen nnaa mwaan fun ɗesǝ nǝn nɗen kǝ jeel, kǝ lée ɗe mun kǝ mo nɗǝǝn tii nǝ mon ntǝkook, ɗang tii mǝnǝn ntǝkook, dǝm wul kǝ seen fun mo zak.>>
Jir aasǝ baa ngwe ɗeɗes nkaa shiitoon nǝ mo, leɗyeen mpwoo ɗe Pool sat kas, tǝng wur nkǝlǝng a pwoo mǝ ngutung tii nǝ ɗak, kǝ mǝ ngu tii nǝ met mbii ɗe Pool sat nwur.

Baa peeɗar mǝ tii ɗesǝ nii ret ntarkut kas, a kǝsǝ ɓǝ ɗes mǝ gurum nǝ mo ɓeet nǝ, ngyel mǝ yool aku mpeemǝnǝ, kǝ koo ɗe arang yii ɓǝ mu nwul ɗi nFoniks, ɗe nǝ a mee pee am kuur ɗeret nɗǝǝn pee nkaam nKrit, nii naa gaar ngyeen, nsar puusru, kǝ ngaar ndeng nsar puusru zak, mu hos ntarkut a mpee mǝnǝ.
Kut Ɗeɗes Yool Nkaa Am kuur
Kaaɗe kut nǝ ɗoom cut pee lee-lee ngaar ngyeen, ɓǝ mo pan nǝ, nǝn njì wuɗun nciit kǝ pan fur mo, ɓǝ mo dul ɓwootsǝǝp nǝ, kǝ mmo tung tii nǝ shindǝm kus kǝ pǝkom ɗǝǝr mǝ yil nKrit.
Ɗangɓǝ kaaɗe mo lang ɗi lee, ɓǝ mee kut ɗeɗes ɗe moo pet a Yurakium dǝ nǝ put nnar kwang ɗeng kǝ sar puus kaa nǝ cutpee jì ɗi nkaa pee nkaam nǝ.
Kaaɗe kut ɗeɗes nǝ cut tii nǝ, ɓǝ baa tii nǝ mak dǝm ngaar pee ɗe kut nǝ kǝ jì ɗe kas. Ɓǝ mu yit nkut nǝ tǝp mun shindǝm ɗi mmee ngaar ɗyik.
Mu ɗel shigǝng mǝrep mee yil ɗe am neer ciirkaat ɗe moo pet a Kauda. A purut-purut ɗang mu mak ɓwoot làa tii nǝ nkaa ɗeɗes nǝ.

Aɓwoon ɗe mo kǝ ɗiyeep làa tii nǝ le nɗǝǝn tii ɗeɗes nǝ, ɓǝ mo ɓwoot teng shin ciir nkaa tii ɗeɗes nǝ. Mo sham kǝ nlǝr mǝ tii nǝ mo. Mbǝɗǝ mo kǝǝr nǝ, taji kut nǝ tǝp tii nǝ dǝm shweer shi pǝkom ɗyees nSirtis kas. Mo dul ɓwootsǝǝp mǝ tii nǝ kàa nɗǝǝn am nǝ kǝn mmo yit, kǝn nkut nǝ tǝp tii nǝ shindǝm ɗi.
Mbǝɗǝ kut nǝ ɗes zam, ɗang nǝ fes yoon mun ɗes zam. Daar nǝ, ɓǝ mo ɗoom kok pak lee ɗe mo nɗǝǝn tii nǝ car mɓut am.
Parpuus ɗekun nǝ zak, ɓǝ mo shikáa fur, mo kok lee tii nǝ mo car mɓut am zak.
Mu cìn teer mo ɗes, baa mu mak naa puus koo zar mo kas. Ɗee a kut ɗeɗes, kǝ tungzung mo kàa paa mun ɗak, ɗe nǝ le kǝn mmun put kǝ pǝtuup nǝ baa mun mbar kas.

Mbǝɗǝ gurum nǝ mo kǝ cìn teer mo ɗes nnen se mbiise, ɓǝ Pool yool nnaar mo, ɓǝ wur sat nǝnee, <<Daa mo, katɗang dǝ wu kǝlǝng pwoo fen, ɓǝ baa dǝ wun nyool nɗǝǝn yil nKrit, kǝn nwun shwaajeel ɗesǝ, kǝn nwun bǝlang nlée fuu mo kǝrong kas.
Mbǝmǝnǝ an pǝ sat nwun, wu yaa pǝtuup fuu mo, mbǝɗe baa mee gurum nɗǝǝn wun, mbǝ mmuut kas, a tii nǝn mpyan kash-kash ɗak.
Mbǝɗǝ dǝdoon mpar, ɓǝ mee ngulep mǝ Naan ɗe an a mǝwur, kǝ ɗe an kǝn nseyil nwur zak, wur jì woo shin nghan.

<<Ɓǝ wur sat nghan nǝnee, <Taji kǝǝrmuut yaa gha kas Pool. Nǝ a tǝng gha mbǝ ɗar ntoom kǝ Siza. A naa Naan kǝ cìn ɗeret ngha, ashak kǝ nen ɗe mo nɗǝǝn tii nǝ jir. Baa mee gurum nɗǝǝn tii nǝn mmuut kas.>
Mbǝ mǝnǝ, daa mo, wu cìn retnyit. Mbǝɗǝ wen nshinzeen nNaan nǝ, mbii ɗe mo woo nghan, ɓǝ nǝn ncìn a kǝsǝ.
Ɗang jir kǝsǝ ɓǝ kut nǝn tǝp tii nǝ shweer nkaa mee yil ɗe am neer nǝ ciirkaat.>>
Tii Nǝ Pyan Kash-Kash
Nɗǝǝn teer ɗe kaapaat baafeer nǝ, ɓǝ kut nǝ tǝp mun kàa kǝ sham nɗǝǝn am kuur mǝ Adriya. Yaksǝ nnaar par, ɓǝ nen tii nǝ mo pan nǝ, muu wul kus kǝ mee yil.
Ɓǝ mo kam lu mǝ am nǝ, ɓǝ mo kat nǝ a shii mo kambil mǝndong kǝ laarvǝl (120). Kaaɗe mu gyes mu dǝm ɗi lee, ɓǝ mo cin shin kam lu mǝ am nǝ ɗe zak, ɓǝ mo kat nǝ wul a shii laarpwoofeer (90).
Mbǝ kǝǝrmuut ɗe nǝ, meesǝ, kut nǝn ndǝm shweer tii nǝ nkaa ngǝk, ɓǝ mo fwen ɓwootsǝǝp nǝ mo sham feer mɓwoon mǝ tii nǝ, mbǝkǝ ntii nǝ ɗar ɗi coot, mbǝɗe mo le pan nkaa ɓit ɗe nǝn mbǝ mang.

Nentung tii nǝ mo nkaa yap ar ɗe mon nshwe yit tii nǝ ɗi, ɓǝ mo kǝ ten shang làa tii nǝ shinsham mɓut am kuur nǝ. Mo cìn kǝsǝ a mbǝ gwam gurum mo, kǝn mmo naa ɗi nǝ, wuɗun a mbǝ fwo ɓwootsǝǝp nǝ ɗe mon mpǝkyeen mǝ tii nǝ, ɗe moo ɓwet shinsham sǝ.
Ɗangɓe Pool sat ngwe ɗeɗes mǝ shiitoon nǝ mo nǝnee, <<Katɗang ɓǝ baa nentung tii nǝ mo tong ɗi nɗǝǝn tii nǝ kas, ɓǝ wu mmurep jir.>>
Ɓǝ shiitoon mo can teng mǝ làa tii nǝ, mo yit nǝ sham taa nɗǝǝn am nǝ, yaksǝ kut mang nǝ seet kǝ nǝ.
Kaaɗe ɓit kus kǝ mang, ɓǝ Pool sat ngurum nǝ mo jir kǝ mmo se mbiise, wur sat nǝnee, <<A teer mo kaapaat baafeer nɗesǝ, ɓǝ wun pǝ tong gongpee, kǝ baa wu se mee mbiise kas.
Mbǝmǝnǝ kǝn ɗang pǝ wun, mbǝkǝ nwun se mbiise, mbǝɗe mǝnǝn nshínɓal nwun nɗǝǝn shik fuu mo. Baa mee shweepkáa mǝ mee gurum mǝndong nɗǝǝn wun nǝn nloom kas.>>
Kaaɗe Pool sat pwoo mǝnǝ, ɓǝ wur mang gǝǝl aas, ɓǝ wur ɗangnaan ɗe mǝ plang Naan a yit gurum nǝ mo jir, ɓǝ wur tep gǝǝl aas nǝ, ɓǝ wur yaa se nǝ.
Yaksǝ gurum nǝ mo jir mo kat retnyit, ɓǝ mo shikáa fur mo se gǝǝl aas nǝ zak.
Mun gurum ɗe mun nɗǝǝn tii nǝ jir, mu wul kambil vǝl kǝ laarpwoovǝl kǝ peemee (276).
Kaaɗe gurum mo se mbiise mo ǝɓǝl, ɓǝ mo kok aàs ɗǝɓen ɗe nǝ nɗǝǝn tii nǝ, mo car shinsham mɓut am kuur nǝ, kǝn ntii nǝ pan fiyeel ɗi.
Kaaɗe ɓitmang, ɓǝ baa nentung tii nǝ mo man yil ɗe mo ɗi nǝ kas, ɓǝ mo naa mee pǝkom ɗǝǝr ɗe nǝ kǝ ɗyees, ɓǝ mo ɓeet nǝ, katɗang nǝ mak cìn, ɓǝ mo dǝm kǝ tii ɗi pǝkom nǝ.

Ɓǝ mo saa teng ɗe mo yaa ɓwootsǝǝp nǝ mo, kǝn mmo yit ɓwootsǝǝp nǝ mo mɓut am kuur nǝ, kǝn mmo fween teng ɗe moo yaa mbii ciir kǝ tii nǝ. Yaksǝ mo ɗiyeep nlǝr ɗe nǝn mpǝkyeen mǝ tii nǝ nkor ɗe kut kǝ jì ɗi, ɓǝ mo yaa ar dǝm pǝkom ɗǝǝr.
Ɗangɓǝ kaaɗe mu wul mmee mpee ɗe kut kǝ cut am nǝ jì kaat ɗi, ɓǝ tii nǝ ɗel shamru mɓut ɗiyees, ɗe baa nǝ kutɗi kǝ tungpee kas, ɓǝ koor mɓwoon mǝ tii nǝ ɗoom pyan, mbǝ ɓal mǝ kut ɗe nii cut nǝ.
Yaksǝ shiitoon nǝ mo ɓeetpwoo, mbǝ twe nen ɗe mo a ɓuɓwoot jir, mbǝkǝ taji mo cut lung, kǝ mo dǝm loom ɗi kas.
Ɗangɓǝ ngwe ɗeɗes nkaa shiitoon nǝ mo, kǝ reɓet ɓam Pool, ɓǝ wur cíi mmo. Wur le kǝ nnen ɗe mo man lung jir, mo mǝrep sham mɓut am nǝ, kǝn mmo taa lung dǝm wul ɗe a pwoo ɗǝǝr.
Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓǝ koor gurum nǝ mo mǝrep sham taa nkaa shiyeep mo, kǝ pak mo nkaa yoom mǝ tii ɗe nǝ pyan nǝ zak.
